name: Modern SEO - Module 3 Core 30
body:
> Course · 2026-10-22

Part of: [Modern SEO Course](lib:brain-modern-seo-course) | [Learning Index](lib:brain-learning-index)

# Summary
Module 3 (3 lessons, about 17.5 minutes) is the advanced stage, used when the three-step method has plateaued in a competitive market. It defines Core 30 (a page for every GBP category and service, linked like the GBP), shows how to find the missing pages (Screaming Frog crawl plus a Claude gap analysis), and how to draft them quickly (single prompt content). Theme across all three lessons: AI speeds up the work, but every output must be checked by a person.

# Lessons
- [Modern SEO - M3L1 What the Core 30 Framework Is](lib:brain-modern-seo-m3l1-what-the-core-30-framework-is): definition, three page levels, linking that mirrors the GBP, trigger (stuck below 10 to 15% after 8 to 10 weeks), the "lobby test", when to stop.
- [Modern SEO - M3L2 Core 30 Gap Analysis](lib:brain-modern-seo-m3l2-core-30-gap-analysis): Screaming Frog exports, Claude gap analysis prompt, the AI getting it wrong, re-prompting and verifying; about 45 minutes for 3 to 4 months of content.
- [Modern SEO - M3L3 Single Prompt Content Creation](lib:brain-modern-seo-m3l3-single-prompt-content-creation): category and service page prompts, 15 to 25 pages, 80% draft plus 20% human edit, "Miami vs Denver" and accuracy checks.

# Combined process
1. Confirm Core 30 is needed (three steps done right, stuck below 10 to 15% green after 8 to 10 weeks).
2. Rule out fundamentals (technical, authority, indexing).
3. Map the GBP (primary, secondary categories, services) in the PowerPoint template.
4. Crawl the site; export internal_all.csv and links_all.csv.
5. Run the gap analysis prompt in Claude with crawl files, homepage content, categories, services, city.
6. Verify every "missing" page in internal_all; make the AI re-audit and explain its priorities.
7. Lock the roadmap: pages to build and pages to optimize, in order.
8. Draft with the category or service page prompt; check local specificity and facts; human edit.
9. Publish with the Core 30 linking structure.
10. Watch the rank map; at 20 to 40% green, move to geographic relevance.

# Numbers (instructor claims)
- Trigger: below 10 to 15% green after 8 to 10 weeks. Typical Core 30 markets: over 500,000 people or several strong competitors.
- Screaming Frog free up to 500 URLs. Gap analysis about 45 minutes. Most businesses need 15 to 25 new pages. Prompt output is about 80% of the final page.

# Open questions
- "Core 30" as a name is never explained.
- The PowerPoint template and all prompts are on the course page, not in the videos.
- The two-prompt content process is in the paid Pro upgrade only (needs Kim's OK; noted, not recommended).
